d.t: Low viscosity, solvent free epoxy Primer and general purpose Binder resin
d.s: Sikafloor-94 is a two component, low viscosity, 100% Solid Epoxy Primer and Binder resin system
a: Can be accelerated with Sikafloor Booster
us: Primer for concrete surfaces with Sikafloor resin systems.
Binder resin for Epoxy mortar Sub-fill mortar screeds.
Flow and scratch coat layering prior to Sikafloor systems.
d.pk: Available in proportioned 30 kg, 60 litres and Bulk 200 kg Parts A+B

sec.t: Potable Water certified to AS 4020 - 2014 VOC compliance to Aust. Green Building Codes V1.1-13.1.1 and V1.1-12.1.1B
Stored in original sealed containers within the temperature range of +5 to +35 degress C, this product will keep for 3 years from date of manufactre.
Stored in a dry place and out of direct sunlight within temperatures as mentioned above.
Part A Part B = 2 :1 (by Mass and Volume)
Application range recommended +5 to +30 Degrees C
10 Degrees C - 30 mins. 20 Degrees C - 20 mins.
10 degrees C 15 hours 20 degrees C 8 hours Note: Waiting times are approximately halved with the addition of Sikafloor Booster
Primer CSP 2-3 profile 5-6m2 L approx. CSP 4-5 profile 2-3m2 L approx. Mortar Range of 1:5 to 1:8 mixed litre of Sikafloor-94 to kg blended silica sands
Part A and B to be mixed the correct ratio for a minimum of 2 minutes

Primer Roll product evenly on and into the surface. If the product is completely absorbed then an additional coat should be applied within 24 hours. Mortar When used as a binder in Profiling screeds or Coving mixes, the substrate should also be primed with Sikafloor-94

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Containers which are opened must be carefully resealed and kept upright to prevent leakage. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: No special measures required. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3 Rubber aprons

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
